fields.statement: Verifier at fcc25e3e: read the diff (internal/api/inbox.go adds InboxItem.Questions []InboxGateQuestion {handle, statement, blocks, recommendation, reasons} read from the run's worktree for open items, and BlocksTitle on blockers, printed by Human). Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox|describe-golden)' -v: all 13 inbox scripts, including the new inbox-gate-questions, and describe-golden PASS. inbox-gate-questions sets up a plan run stopped at its gate on two open questions (park-disk, park-format) plus an accepted change set's blocker. rhiza inbox prints each full statement with its handle and what it blocks by statement, and the blocker as 'blocks: Kept (store)'. --json carries each question's handle and statement, blocks 'Exports-go-to-the-store' and blocks_title 'Kept'. After a journalled advisor recommendation, both text and --json show the recommendation and reasons. Also ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... (ok); gofmt -l and go vet on internal/api are clean. Note: a separate restatement field is not part of this leaf; the sibling advisor leaf adds it, and this leaf shows the advisor's recorded recommendation text and reasons.
